issue.title: Extract prose sections into prose notes and inline them back
issue.description: One Obsidian gesture turns an authored section of an area, project, or prose note into a prose note, and the same gesture folds it back. bob prose extract and bob prose inline own the conversion in Rust: previewed, preimage-guarded, all-or-nothing, link-repairing, crash-recoverable, and lossless on a round trip. Extraction records provenance that the later reversible-projects work can consume.
